(1) stream_config_test.go:421-427 now names the race as the background removal of the account's streams directory, which nats-server schedules on every stream delete and which succeeds once that directory is empty. (2) kvwatch_test.go:812-819 now says each delete 'leaves the directory empty — once the deleted stream's renamed copy … is gone — so the removal it schedules can succeed'. 'can succeed' carries the race: the renamed copy sits in that same streams directory until its own goroutine removes it, and until then the scheduled os.Remove fails. (3) Read together, the two comments describe one race in one way: the account's streams directory, removed by os.Remove only when empty, with the renamed copy as the reason it is not empty at once.
